title: 2021 Disclosure of Interest Information: GINA Board of Directors, GINA Science Committee
journal: Global Initiative for Asthma, disclosure of financial interest for 1 January to 31 December 2021, posted April 2022
result: The document describes the GINA program as 'a collaboration between the scientific community and the private sector' and states that the private sector should not be involved in any aspect of developing documents, while asthma-related commercial organisations can be involved in dissemination and audit once documents are produced, including support for publications. The Board chair, L-P Boulet, declared institutional grants and consulting and lecture fees involving AstraZeneca, GlaxoSmithKline, Merck, Novartis and Sanofi-Regeneron among others; the Science Committee chair, H K Reddel, declared an AstraZeneca investigator-sponsored research grant and personal fees from AstraZeneca for advisory boards, steering committee work, independent medical education and consultancy, with GlaxoSmithKline, Novartis, Chiesi and Sanofi also listed.
